text: {"verdict": "ABSTAIN", "rule": "I8", "rationale": "The campaign_class 'routine_composition_screen' is not in the CAMPAIGN CAPABILITIES list, so no allowed-action set is defined and I8 cannot be checked. The plan does not say which element each comp_vec index means, so I4 (Ce+Mn) cannot be checked either. The negative entry (-10) is unusual, but no written rule covers it.
